name: context-document
description: Authoritative living documents with stable scoped slots and same-ID content replacement.

interface.shortDescription: Keep living project documents durable and current.
interface.longDescription: Captures project-scoped living documents as authoritative artifacts and replaces Content under a stable ID through context-core approval and storage.
defaultPrompt: Use active language; keep machine fields English. Claim only a living document with one stable scoped slot.
Update Content by replace_same_state while retaining the current artifact ID, path, scope, and document_key.
Produce drafts and receipts only. Delegate every persistent write, lock, CAS, preview, and apply to context-core.
